sections.description: Embed elements from your connected platform — gift card designer and more — via shortcode, Elementor widget, or block. The plugin only places secure embeds; all checkout and payment flows run on the platform.
sections.changelog:
0.8.1

  • Catalog docks flush under the site menu when scrolling pauses near it — one scroll context instead of two competing ones; the rest of the page stays reachable.

0.8.0

  • New shortcodes: [wncpay_tour id] (single tour page), [wncpay_how_it_works], [wncpay_pay reference]. mode="window|auto" attribute on every shortcode. Full shortcode reference table added to Settings → WNC Pay.

0.7.5

  • Context-aware catalog: the embed learns which site page the visitor came from and opens the matching tour directly, or pre-filters to the matching category. Same-site referrers only.

0.7.4

  • Individual tour pages opened from the embedded catalog take the whole screen while viewed; Back returns to the catalog and restores the window.

0.7.3

  • Embed forms/popups (quote basket, request form, previews) expand the frame full-screen while open, so they stack above the site menu and floating buttons; the frame restores on close.

0.7.2

  • Tour catalog embeds in window mode: the frame fills the visitor's screen below the site menu and the catalog scrolls inside it — sticky toolbar with zero lag, cart and popups open centered. mode="auto" on the shortcode restores full-height mode.

0.7.1

  • Embeds stream their frame's viewport position into the platform page so embedded toolbars can pin themselves below the site's menu while scrolling. Purely visual; nothing to configure.

0.7.0

  • TEST payments (gateway Test mode or the magic test ID at checkout) now stamp the WooCommerce order with a TEST note and meta — test orders can never be mistaken for real revenue.

0.6.0

  • New embeds: [wncpay_trip_planner] (trip-builder wizard) and [wncpay_tour_catalog] (multi-tour interactive catalog) — host the platform inside the site.
  • Cross-site failover: a blocked embed swaps itself for an 'Open in a new tab' card instead of a blank frame.

0.5.0

  • Test mode (gateway setting): checkouts are sent as TEST transactions — processed against the PayMe sandbox, the PayMe test card approves for real, no actual money moves, everything is stamped [TEST] on the platform and excluded from revenue and the CRM. A yellow TEST banner shows at checkout while enabled. Turn OFF before go-live.

0.4.0

  • Deposit flow (configurable %, default 30) for tours pending office availability confirmation, with checkout stipulation; order completes when the balance webhook arrives.
  • Per-product "full payment" checkbox for instant items.
  • Required preferred-date question at checkout for tour items.

0.3.6

  • Traveller count sent with each gateway order (Appointments persons or quantities) — fills the CRM deal's Amount of People automatically.

0.3.5

  • Full shortcode reference + examples on Settings → WNC Pay.
  • Fix: dealid shortcode attribute now reaches the platform correctly.

0.3.4

  • Multi-item carts use the platform's multiple-tours document variant.

0.3.3

  • Order-received page + customer emails link to the platform account after a WNC Pay payment.

0.3.2

  • Brand logo across the gateway checkout, settings page and update screens.

0.3.0

  • WooCommerce payment gateway: appears under WooCommerce → Settings → Payments; checkout redirects to the platform's secure payment page; orders completed by signed platform webhooks. ILS carts, HPOS compatible.
  • Connection status indicator on Settings → WNC Pay.

0.2.0

  • Native WordPress updates via the public wncpay-update channel.

0.1.0

  • First release: settings page, embed core with auto-height and WPML-aware locale, Gift Card Designer as Elementor widget + shortcode + block.
